p: two sons: Joseph valued his children being received into Jacob's family, which was the Church of God, more than enjoying all the treasures of Egypt.
everlasting possession: Which is true in the carnal Israel until the coming of Christ, and in the spiritual forever.
God hath given me in this: The faithful acknowledge all benefits come from God's free mercy.
Ephraim's head: God's judgments are often contrary to man's and he prefers what man despises.
Angel which redeemed me from all: This angel must be understood to be Christ, as in Ge 31:13,32:1.
name be named on them: Let them be taken as my children.
displeased him: Joseph fails by binding God's grace to the order of nature.
Ephraim and as Manasseh: In whom God's graces should manifestly appear.
your fathers: Which they had by faith in the promise.
I took out of the hand: By my children whom God spared for my sake.
